newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator jumps 14 cents to 673c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator jumps 14 cents to 673c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose 14 cents to 673 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at this week's opening sales in Sydney compared to the Sydney and Melbourne sales last Wednesday, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was dearer, with 19m two percent dearer, 20/23m up to 3.5 percent dearer, 21m 2.5 percent dearer, 22m two percent dearer, 24m three percent dearer, and 25m 1.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 26/28m were slightly dearer, 27m 0.5 percent dearer, 29m slightly cheaper and 30/31m one percent cheaper.
In cardings, washing locks were unchanged, light carbonising locks two percent cheaper and crutchings generally unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 13,124 bales offered, 6.5 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Fremantle with about 31,700 bales to be offered.
